note: In the ledger, `sources` holds indices into `sources` below, and method fields hold indices into `methods`.
methods: Reproved official own code/state and immediate tier; unchanged stored point strictly inside raw own municipio polygon; complete in-state identity scan independent of points suppresses existing municipio entities; numeric 2020 municipio LOC=0000 population on additions; current full-row/incoming-edge guards; v4 continuity for child links.

sources.edition: Censo de Población y Vivienda 2020, ITER, 2020-03-15 reference date
sources.licence: INEGI Terms of Free Use; copying, adaptation and commercial use permitted with product/source attribution and transformation notice

source_currentness: Wikidata re-read in work2 with fresh receipts. Official catalogue/geometry and 2020 census are hash-verified retained editions at their original capture dates; ordinary direct INEGI refresh failed (receipts in work2/sources). No live-current INEGI claim.
population_policy: Every kept addition uses numeric AGEEML POB_TOTAL equal to 2020 ITER municipio LOC=0000 POBTOT. Missing totals are held; no seat totals, zeros, nulls or estimates substituted.
